title: Sign of the Integer Encoding
statement: For $s\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and $a\in\mathbb{N}$, encode the pair by the integer $-a-1$ when $s$ is true and by $a$ when $s$ is false. The sign indicator that is true exactly for negative integers, applied to this encoding, equals $s$.
